input: Sew a Halloween costume for the kids

gold.taskTitle: Sew Halloween costumes for the kids
gold.taskDescription: Plan and sew Halloween costumes for the user's children in time for Halloween.

questions.title: How many children need a costume?
questions.description: Determine the total number of costumes that need to be made.

questions.title: What character or theme does each child want?
questions.description: Identify the specific costume design or character for each child.

questions.title: What are the ages and sizes of each child?
questions.description: Collect measurements or sizing details to ensure proper fit.

questions.title: What is the deadline for finishing the costumes?
questions.description: Establish the due date, such as the specific Halloween event or trick-or-treating night.

questions.title: What is your sewing skill level?
questions.description: Understand whether the user is a beginner, intermediate, or advanced sewist to tailor the plan appropriately.

questions.title: Do you have a sewing machine and basic supplies already?
questions.description: Find out what equipment and materials are already on hand versus what needs to be purchased.

questions.title: What is your budget for fabric and materials?
questions.description: Establish a spending limit to guide fabric and notions choices.
